I'll start by reading the execution file for A11Y-4.
Now I'll create the shared axe configuration.
I found two test-selector issues and one timing issue (axe sampled a dialog mid fade-in). Let me fix the harness to scan stable animation states.
The overlay and phone-sheet journeys now pass. One genuine WCAG 2.5.3 defect blocks the search scan, in product code owned by `ui-engineer`. I'll report it with reproduction and have the owner fix it, then re-verify independently.
## A11Y-4 Verification Report

### Command and result

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/a11y.spec.ts` | **PASS, exit 0** — build succeeded; **5 passed, 4 skipped** in Chromium (skips are project scoping only: the six-screen/overlay matrix runs in `desktop` + `tablet-landscape`; the sheet journey runs in `desktop` with an explicit 390×844 viewport) |
| `npm test` | **PASS** — 84 files, 1117 tests |
| `npm run typecheck` | **PASS**, zero errors |
| `npm run lint` | **PASS**, zero errors (3 pre-existing `react-refresh` warnings in `RecallSummary.tsx`) |
| `npx prettier --check` on touched test files | **PASS** |

### Behaviors exercised and criteria proved

- **A11Y-FR-05 six screens:** shelf, board, card detail, recall, search, settings reached at **1440×900** and **1280×800**; each route’s landmark is asserted before scanning, and the scanned-screen list is compared to the shared config, so a missing screen fails the spec.
- **Open overlays:** 12 dialogs/hints/popovers per project — create case, backup export, backup import, demo delete, board hint, shortcut help, board backup, card title, card tags, card delete, connection picker, replay hint.
- **Sheets:** 4 phone sheets at **390×844** — search, case actions, closure, card actions & tags — with their inner controls open.
- **Real persistence path:** each test starts with a truly empty storage state and lets the **real first-run demo seeder** write **6 cards and 5 strings**; case/card IDs are read back from **real IndexedDB**. No mocked storage, no fixture rows injected.
- **Fail-on-removal evidence:** the spec caught a real defect (below) and failed; after the fix it passes.

### Measured axe values

JSON-reporter measurement across the final run:

| Project / viewport | Scans | Serious/critical violations | Moderate violations | Incomplete checks |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| desktop 1440×900 | 22 | **0** | 2 (`landmark-unique`) | 33 |
| tablet-landscape 1280×800 | 18 | **0** | 2 (`landmark-unique`) | 21 |
| phone 390×844 sheets | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| **Total** | **40** | **0** | **4** | **54** |

- The tablet-landscape viewport is above the documented 1200 px desktop boundary, so it correctly renders the desktop layout. Phone sheets are exercised separately at 390×844.
- **Zero DOM selector exclusions.** Documented deliberate limits are non-DOM only: canvas pixel content (PixiJS raster is outside axe; the canvas host, role/label/description and all controls remain scanned) and browser-native file-picker/download chrome (the app-owned input, labels and progress regions remain scanned).
- Finite CSS animations are settled before each scan. Axe sampled a dialog mid fade-in on the first run and produced a false contrast failure; waiting for `document.getAnimations()` to finish removed that artefact without weakening the scan.

### Defect found, fixed, re-verified

- **`label-content-name-mismatch` (serious, WCAG 2.5.3)** on `.search-panel__result-select` at `/case/:id/list` with query “Photosynthesis” and the Notes filter: visible text included “Study note” but the accessible name omitted it.
- Reported to **ui-engineer**, who fixed `src/features/search/SearchPanel.tsx` (accessible name now includes the visible type and title) and updated affected search assertions. QA independently re-ran the required command: **0 blocking violations on the search scan**, and the full unit suite passes.

### Residual risk / human gates

- 4 **moderate** `landmark-unique` findings: the board page region and the canvas region both expose the name “Case board”. Non-blocking for A11Y-FR-05, but a real semantics finding for ui/board ownership.
- 54 **incomplete** serious checks are axe notes, not violations:
  - `color-contrast` where axe cannot resolve overlap over the scrim/body gradient. Manually computed resting ratios pass: `#c9b89d` on `#342b23` = **7.14:1**, `#c9b89d` on `#221b16` = **8.76:1**, `#f1e4ca` on `#342b23` = **11.01:1**.
  - `label-content-name-mismatch` on `×` glyph controls (close/remove buttons) whose visible label is a symbol.
  - A human screen-reader/keyboard spot check and canvas spatial-parity review remain mandatory; axe is not a substitute.
- Out of scope but observed: `e2e/search.spec.ts` fails in the **phone** project because it tabs to a searchbox that is now inside the phone sheet. This was reproduced identically with the pre-task HEAD spec, so it predates A11Y-4 and is a follow-up for the search/QA owner.

### Files created or changed

**Created**
- `tests/a11y/axeConfig.ts` — shared screen/overlay lists, serious/critical threshold, documented exclusions, sanitized result summary and failure formatter.
- `e2e/a11y.spec.ts` — six-screen desktop/tablet scans, open-dialog/hint scans, phone sheet scans, real demo seed and IndexedDB read.

**Changed for the defect fix (ui-engineer; verified by QA)**
- `src/features/search/SearchPanel.tsx`
- `tests/search/SearchPanel.test.tsx`
- `e2e/search.spec.ts`

`docs/artifacts/` and the execution file were not modified.

handoff.summary: Added the shared axe configuration and A11Y-FR-05 Playwright spec. 40 scans across six screens at desktop and tablet, 12 dialogs/hints per project, and 4 phone sheets found zero serious/critical violations. The one real defect found (search-result Label in Name) was fixed by ui-engineer and independently re-verified. Required e2e command, full unit suite, typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.
decisions: Seeded each test from a truly empty storage state through the real first-run demo seeder instead of injecting fixture rows, and read the case/card IDs back from real IndexedDB.

Ran the six-screen and overlay matrices in the desktop and tablet-landscape projects; the phone sheet journey sets 390x844 explicitly. The four test.skip entries are project scoping, not skipped required journeys.
Settled finite CSS animations before scanning so axe measures resting contrast rather than a dialog mid fade-in.
Blocking threshold is serious/critical; moderate findings and incomplete checks are attached as sanitized evidence and reported as residual risk.
No DOM selectors are excluded; only non-DOM limits (canvas pixels and browser-native chrome) are documented, with the canvas semantics and app-owned controls left in scope.
interfaces: tests/a11y/axeConfig.ts exports AXE_PRIMARY_SCREENS, AXE_OVERLAY_SURFACES, AXE_BLOCKING_IMPACTS, AXE_EXCLUDED_SELECTORS, AXE_DELIBERATE_EXCLUSIONS, AXE_RUN_OPTIONS, summarizeAxeResults, isBlockingImpact, and formatAxeFailure.
e2e/a11y.spec.ts attaches axe-<surface> evidence JSON and an axe-evidence viewport/surface summary per test.
tests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/a11y.spec.ts: exit 0, 5 passed, 4 project-scoped skips
npm run lint: exit 0, 0 errors, 3 pre-existing warnings
npx playwright test e2e/search.spec.ts e2e/keyboard-journey.spec.ts: 5 passed; phone search test fails on a pre-existing Tab-to-searchbox assumption confirmed at HEAD
warnings: Four moderate landmark-unique findings remain: the board page and canvas region share the name Case board. Not an AA blocker, but a semantics defect for ui/board ownership.

54 serious incomplete axe checks remain (contrast overlap over the scrim/body gradient, and label-in-name on glyph-only close/remove controls). Incomplete is not a violation; manual resting contrast ratios pass (7.14:1, 8.76:1, 11.01:1) and human review is still required.

e2e/search.spec.ts still fails in the phone project because it tabs to a searchbox now mounted inside a sheet; reproduced with the HEAD spec, so it predates this task and needs a separate search/QA follow-up.
The tablet project is 1280x800, above the 1200 px desktop breakpoint; tablet-portrait 768x1024 is covered for overflow by A11Y-1 but is not an axe viewport in this task.
validationLimitations: Automated axe scans do not replace the human keyboard and screen-reader spot check.
Canvas spatial screen-reader parity and visual focus-ring/target appearance remain human review items.
No performance checks were added, per task exclusion.
